tasks.title: Shots by distance
tasks.statement: The survey leg is **{L} m**, the `DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_DIST` command is **{d} m** with the "shoot immediately" parameter (param3 = 1). What is the maximum number of shots to expect if a shot falling exactly at the end of the leg is not taken (ignore the accumulated overshoot of the 50 Hz check)?
tasks.solution: The first shot is taken right on the command (param3 = 1), then one every d m with a small overshoot, so the point exactly at the end of the leg already falls past it: 1 + ⌈L/d⌉ − 1 = ⌈L/d⌉. Without param3 = 1 there is no first shot: the firmware only remembers the point (then ⌈L/d⌉ − 1, as in the `ap-payload` task). On a long leg with a small d the overshoot of up to v · 0.02 m per shot accumulates and can cost more shots, hence "maximum".
